bio: Treat yourself to a delicious Afternoon Tea at Peperina Garden Bistro, a charming eatery right in the heart of Dublin's Ranelagh.  With its sunny, yellow exterior and its vibrant, welcoming decor, Peperina Garden Bistro is a favourite amongst locals and tourists alike. Enjoy Afternoon Tea in cosy surroundings or, in warmer months, relax and unwind on their Outdoor Terrace & Herb Garden - the perfect spot to while away the afternoon.  Their Afternoon Tea menu comprises a delicious array of finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones with clotted cream and raspberry jam and a sumptuous selection of sweet treats. All of this is served alongside a pot of tea of your choice and, if you're feeling especially decadent, a glass of Prosecco.  Peperina Garden Bistro is easily located, just a 1-minute walk from Beechwood LUAS stop.
